title: CHG-5385: change to the Device Registry
body:
Summary

This memo records a change to the Device Registry that is currently approved.
The work affects 13 production hosts behind the Device Registry and was raised
by Nadia Karim from Release Management.

Details

The implementation plan, prepared with Corvid Analytics, covers these steps
during the 06:00-07:00 UTC window:
- Move the nightly export to the new object store bucket
- Enable TLS 1.3 on the internal load balancer listeners
- Archive records older than seven years to cold storage

Decision

Board outcome for CHG-5385: approved. Jonas Berg filed this record on 26
December 2025 after the board session of 22 November 2025; minutes are in the
shared archive.
